title: poops-images configuration
description: Responsive image processing — resize, convert, crop, EXIF. This is the whole of a poops-images.json, and also the value of the `images` key in a poops.json. https://github.com/stamat/poops-images

$schema.description: URL or path of this schema. Ignored by poops-images; editors read it for completion and validation.

out.description: Output directory. Keep it out of `in` — and, under Poops, outside the watched sources, or generated variants retrigger the build.

sizes.description: Variants to generate. Left empty, nothing is resized and the run is a format conversion.

format.description: Output formats. `false` normalises to a web-ready format, "smart" keeps whichever of jpg and webp came out smaller, or name the formats yourself.

quality.description: One number for every format, or a number per format. 1–100.

skipOriginal.description: Drop the compressed original, keeping only the resized variants.

include.description: Glob of source images, relative to `in`. Governs every pipeline: files ending in .svg or .gif route to the SVG and GIF pipelines, the rest to raster.

cache.description: `true` writes `.poops-images-cache.json` into the output directory, `false` disables caching, a string names the file (relative to the output directory, or absolute). The markup engines read this file, so turning it off costs Poops its image metadata.

preprocessors.description: Extra renditions, each the source put through a chain of operations before the normal size and format pass.

verbose.description: Log every file instead of one summary at the end.

configDir.description: Base for resolving custom handlers and composite overlays. Defaults to the directory this config file sits in — set it only when that is not what you want.

size.description: Mirrors WordPress's add_image_size(name, width, height, crop).

name.description: Appended to the filename. Omit it and the variant is named by width alone. Among sizes sharing a name the largest drops its width suffix, so it reads as the canonical one.

width.description: Target width in px. 0 scales by height alone.

height.description: Target height in px. 0 scales by width alone.

crop.description: `false` fits inside the box and never upscales, `true` covers it from the centre, and a [x, y] pair covers it from that anchor. A crop always produces output: an undersized source is scaled down to the largest box that fits rather than dropped.

name.description: Goes into the output filename. Letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only, and it may not collide with a size name.

sizes.description: Sizes for this rendition alone. Omit it to use the top-level `sizes`.

format.description: Overrides the top-level `format` for this rendition.

quality.description: Overrides the top-level `quality` for this rendition.

skipOriginal.description: Overrides the top-level `skipOriginal` for this rendition.

svg.description: Keep the SVG an operation produced, rather than only its raster.

resizeFirst.description: Resize before the operations run instead of after — an operation whose cost or look depends on pixel dimensions (ascii, halftone) wants this. `true` uses the rendition's own sizes; an object resizes once to a fixed box first.

oneOf.description: Needs a positive `width` or `height` — a box of zero is rejected, unlike a `sizes` entry where zero means "do not resize".

operation.description: A built-in operation, or the name of a custom handler — `handlers/<type>.js` next to this config, or a path to a module. Anything beside `type` is passed to it, which is why unknown keys are allowed here.

type.description: Built in: blur, grayscale, sharpen, tint, modulate, negate, normalize, rotate, flip, flop, gamma, composite. Any other name is looked up as a custom handler.

color.description: Any colour sharp accepts — "#43523d", "rgb(…)", a named colour.

input.description: Overlay image, resolved against `configDir`. A missing file is an error, not a skip.
